source.name: NTA — Examination Calendar up to March 2027 (public notice, 16 Sep 2026)

observations.evidence: Page 2, "Examination Calendar 2027", January 2027, row 9: "JEE (Main) — Session 1 (January) | 22 – 24, 28 – 30 Jan 2027 (buffer: 31 Jan 2027) | 6 Days". Footnote on the same page: "Dates are tentative and may undergo changes owing to administrative, academic, statutory, logistical or other unforeseen circumstances." This covers Session 1 only; the calendar stops at March 2027. Read by eye from a scanned notice, which the fetcher cannot parse — open the PDF and check the row before approving.
